native_status: The initial suite passed 4 of 7 tests: offline download/playback; onboarding/search/likes/queue/background playback; bundled Python/QuickJS/FFmpeg execution; and local-startup/browsing-update suppression. Album playback (15 s) and chapter playback (10 s) waits timed out during the concurrent build. A third failure exposed a delayed queue-save/reset race, which was corrected in the final APK. The final targeted startup/reset run timed out at 180 s; the following adb diagnostic also timed out. The final end-to-end device check is therefore **incomplete**, and the two playback timeouts remain unverified. No live phone startup timing or universal latency guarantee is claimed.
